summary: Set the approved daemon read, write-ack and transaction latency targets to 300 ms.

replay.detail: No canonical data, projection or replay change; latency windows remain process-local measurements.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, migrations or wire fields change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule, rules version, digest or retention change.

compatibility.detail: Built-in person-read and write-ack p99 targets become 300 ms. The transaction maximum becomes 300 ms for reads, writes and writer holds. Remote and fresh reads already use 300 ms; SQL statement targets, database targets and independent daemon_load budgets retain their values.

downtime.detail: No additional restart or downtime is introduced. The next ordinary build and restart uses the updated built-in targets; this source change does not deploy or modify live settings.

manual.detail: No live policy application or configuration action is required by this source change.

recovery.detail: An older build retains its original targets. No stored readings or breach history are rewritten, and no performance improvement is claimed from changing the targets.
